description: This file generates an iCalendar (.ics) export for calendar activities and tasks from the vtiger CRM system, fetching relevant data from the database, creating calendar components, and outputting the serialized calendar.

classes.name: iCalendar_timezone
classes.description: Represents the timezone component of the iCalendar, managing timezone-related properties.

classes.name: iCalendar
classes.description: Main class to handle iCalendar components, adding components, and serialization.

classes.name: iCalendar_event
classes.description: Represents an iCalendar event component, allowing assignment of event-specific properties.

classes.name: iCalendar_alarm
classes.description: Represents an alarm component within the iCalendar, assigning alarm values.

classes.name: iCalendar_todo
classes.description: Represents a to-do component within the iCalendar, for task entries.

methods.name: assign_values
methods.description: Assigns values to the calendar component from a data array.

methods.name: add_component
methods.description: Adds a component (timezone, event, alarm, etc.) to the iCalendar or parent component.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the entire iCalendar object into a string conforming to the iCalendar format.

methods.name: add_property
methods.description: Adds a property (such as TZID, TZOFFSETTO, etc.) to the timezone component.
